changes: Validate episode schema/layout/dtype before committing a batch; reject nonreal actions/rewards and inconsistent proprio dimensions

Move RLinf pinned catalog/artifact helpers below CLI; preserve compatibility functions and replay-window override
Share safe reset-row replacement and avoid repeated per-row schema-set construction
Include documentation evidence in source archives and check an extracted archive in CI
Use POSIX snapshot manifest keys and reject Windows drive paths
Offer opt-in CRC verification before episode publication and SHA256 verification before decoding through the same open descriptor
Hash filesystem paths without unique Path parsing; borrowed-stream hashing preserves ownership and file hashing rejects integer descriptors
